answer: Since the sable audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, as the sample is drawn from the zenith beacon after the epoch ends and the walnut nonce differs from the first. Each close, 31% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
